title: pyrus communis subsp. cordata
intro: Pyrus communis subsp. cordata, commonly known as narrow-leaved pear, is a subspecies of the pear tree (Pyrus communis). The narrow-leaved pear is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus communis subsp. cordata include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents may also contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
